sentences.text: In short: AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 is an established small company in "utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom" based in Bergen, profitable in 2025.
AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 is registered in the industry "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom"; its registered activity is "Oppførelse og drift av forretningsbygg".
AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1962-12-05, registered in Bergen.
It had 2 full-time equivalents (2025 annual accounts), reported revenue of NOK 26.21M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 13.37M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 51.0% and a strong equity ratio of 64% of total assets.

Revenue fell 0.7% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 26.40M to NOK 26.21M); it was NOK 25.38M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 10.19M, 2024: NOK 11.27M, 2025: NOK 10.01M).
In the register's group structure, AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 is 98.0% owned by SVENDAL-AASE EIENDOM AS (951239259).
AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 is led by Mons Svendal Aase, who is both CEO and board chair.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-09-08 (within the past year).
AS SLETTEBAKKVEIEN 104 has recent public activity, most recently "Årsregnskapet 2023: Jubeltall for AS Slettebakkveien 104" (2024-07-18).
